entry_points.text: Removal inline if inactive else on owner, tolerates tombstone; install checks running task, freezes time, links and reschedules kind, else links without reprogramming when task/cgroup elsewhere.
Sched-out entry optimizes or performs switches; sideband iterator broadcasts lifecycle to CPU and task events.

exports.text: Disable: public takes context then internal path; local runs on current CPU; deferred only flags pending and queues async work.
Output: begin reserves sized record with auto direction; end publishes and drops guard; failed begin needs no end; header init fills metadata.
Install links event into context, cross-CPU when hardware may program; enable lifts toward running with reschedule if active; reschedule rebalances one PMU; refresh adds sampling credit then enables.
Filter sync pushes newer generation to hardware; breakpoint modify revalidates, swaps slot on kind change and refreshes details.
User page writes timing, index, offset and totals under sequence lock when buffered; arch hook adds fields, default empty.
Switch-out hook runs PMU callbacks, emits switch records, handles cgroup/clone; inc/dec keep per-CPU subscriber list and count.

hazards.text: Head publish can race interrupts; outer releaser validates and retries; missing/paused/short space counts loss and fails cleanly; backward swaps head/tail roles and negates math, keep distinct.

Stop rechecks active/CPU with barrier, retries on migrate; install races tombstone/migration with barrier, retry and fallback; reschedule widens pinned to flex, brackets with PMU off, admits pinned first; hist needs stable snap, warns negative, zero if empty; trap-path needs privilege; user page NMI-safe.

invariants.text: Aux needed on redirection or aux action; setup needs leader, rejects redirection plus snapshot, checks compat and caps, links after safe ref; teardown clears one link or unlinks all siblings and errors followers.
Final ref frees then drops parent; group detach idempotent, unlinks, adjusts counts, promotes survivors with caps; child detach unlinks once; orphaned is dead.

Clocks update on removal/disable unless frozen; freeze updates then marks; removal picks ceiling from flags, disables to it, detaches and clears empty context; disable no-op at/below off/inactive, leader parks group but only leader goes off.
Throttle on running only; throttle saturates count, stops and marks leaders; unthrottle clears, restarts optionally and marks; group visits leader plus siblings, may skip restarting trigger.

IDs copy mask, capture tid/time/id/stream/CPU in fixed order; reservation redirects inherited to parent, fails without buffer or when paused counting loss, prepends loss plus trailer, checks space unless overwrite with direction roles, claims atomically with watermark wakeup; size is pages shifted plus order; wakeup marks readable and queues work; filter needs wildcard or matching CPU plus group.

Single allowed above disabled, records CPU before publishing active, clears saturated throttle, reverts on hardware failure; group atomic with rollback; software-only always; exclusive blocked by occupant or nonempty list else hardware flag; wildcard overlaps all.

Trace follows parent, emits only for trace-capable unattached PMU with pid/tid; reservation fails if uninit, kind bad, or pinned plus weight over cached slots with rw as data else insn; occupancy is max over mask of per-CPU plus task use.

Occupancy is atomic level distribution with underflow warn, merge gives peak plus one; pinned load scans hash by category, affinity and cost with sentinel on wide/affine clash; toggle keeps CPU-only or task books with fast/slow paths; parse uses arch then rejects bad kernel addr and unpriv trap-path; release derives category/cost; copiers move addr/kind/len/flag or signal.

Modify needs same category, breakpoint only, copies signal then handler on event plus children; equiv only when unpinned with parent linkage; timing uses snapshot clock for NMI safety plus child totals with active fix; index zero unless active unstopped else PMU; sync swaps counters/times pairwise; fan-out skips uninstalled, below-inactive or filtered; order by position.

locks.text: Detach needs context lock; removal needs mutex then spinlock or remote; scheduling needs lock with PMU bracket; reschedule pairs CPU and task locks.
Session holds read guard reserve to end; acquire disables preemption, nests and snapshots wakeup; outer release publishes head, retries on race, signals on progress; inner only unwinds.
Task scope uses task mutex plus semaphore read; system uses semaphore write alone; release reverses; stable hist reads need write, task updates allow read; hash scans under read guard.

Filter sync under spinlock; user page under read guard, preempt off and seqlock; fan-out under read guard and preempt off; modify under child mutex, no parent; PMU callbacks with CPU lock and PMU off; fast swap needs both locks, disabled and no markers.

state_machines.text: States off, inactive, active, error, dead; disable never raises; dead is orphaned; enable lifts to inactive then active; stop only on active.

Active accrues until frozen; sched-out with task callbacks picks fast swapped preserving hardware versus slow parked, gated by equiv and markers; switch only with subscribers, preempt only leaving runnable; slot toggles with hash update, kind change restores on failure.

structs.text: Throttle is header plus clock, id, stream; loss is header plus id and count; handle is page index plus offset and remaining; trace start is header plus pid/tid; stop pairs event with restart flag.

Event has bp target/link, affinity, attrs, counters, timing, prev count, flags, PMU, buffer, context, children; context has lock, pins, gen/parent, counts, lists, task; bp books have per-CPU/global hists and task hash.

Detach bits group1 child2 exit4 revoke8 dead16; saturated count all bits set; only breakpoint modifiable; invalid-arg, perm-denied and not-supported errors as appropriate; inactive minimum for notify, active unstopped for index.
